meshSurgeryReason: 2026-10-11 lane B (standing mesh-surgery approval): the Meshy mesh welds the staff arm's sleeve and hand onto the robe at the left hip (33 bridge faces between the source forearm/hand chain Bone_029..Bone_025 and the hips/spine/left-thigh bones), so the DEF g12/g15 staff raise and forward thrust dragged the robe out with the sleeve (gate +323 edges past 2x, mostly Hips<->LeftForeArm). limb_cut_surgery.py splits the bridge by majority and duplicates the 20 shared vertices (sleeve copies drop the body bones, robe originals drop the arm bones); every original vertex is byte-identical, same mesh at rest. Second cut arm_c2 (from arm_c1, limb_cut_surgery.py --mixed-from, box below the shoulder z 0.5-0.9): the sleeve's inner side still hung onto the torso/robe through a strip of mixed-weight vertices that the first cut's pure-class rule did not see, so the overhead staff raise dragged the robe up with it (Hips<->LeftForeArm, robe Hips-Hips); 24 more bridge faces split, 18 vertices duplicated, originals byte-identical.
